title: Fixed middle basis and copied reversed corners: conditional κ = 3.886675852e-5 > 2^-15
body:
Under the retained analytic and fixed finite-alphabet multitape hypotheses,

**T(n) = O(n (log n)^(1 − κ)), with κ = 971668963/25000000000000 = 3.886675852 × 10⁻⁵ > 2⁻¹⁵.**

This fixes only the middle basis in PR #37's copied reversed (23,25) construction: L25=I+J, with one common generic rational L23. The complete original-envelope middle profile replaces the entire generic middle profile, while the reversed data blocks **21+17+481 with nine singletons** remain compatible.

The saving is **0.9324% above PR #37** (`2f7578affce416ad4b6c41f3438ebb734f66a899`) and **0.011627% above PR #38** (`cc794077f6c103e24ec0939be765cd1521239aab`, 3.886224e-5). PR #38 fixes both bases and uses a conservative single21-block. These comparisons concern conditional asymptotic exponent savings, not measured running time or global optimality.

### Proof and complete accounting

The written common-basis argument uses universal reversed rank cuts and nonzero rational prefix minors on irreducible GL23. All2,300 middle triple lines have complete47-pivot nonvanishing certificates; the proof of zeros comes from inherited all-weight identities, not modular samples. All25 copied-center complements are derived exactly and checked in the actual controlled local contractions.

The complete h25 original-envelope profile is rebuilt from the actual PR #36 **base-two** scalar DAG and original oriented matching. All96,273 profiled matrices are checked under five certified primes; their product exceeds a dimension-specific bound on every relevant integer minor. All actual denominator factors are invertible. Northeast ranks are reconstructed correctly even if modular pivot profiles differ.

Exactly25 width25 cleanup calls become25 rank-one complements; every paid rank24 copied transform and its actual fixed-basis profile remains. The full child list has27 widths and unchanged total rank108,202,762,275. All4,073,300 endpoint-copy corrections remain paid.

The exact bit saving is3886826921/10^14. Both bit and inherited complex moments pass; complex saving717/10^7 and its scalar charge remain. All47 strict assembly conditions, seven margins, p^2000 row stock and eventual cutoffs pass. The semantic envelope includes G_scalar. Ten focused regression/negative controls pass, including rank-preserving block corruption, incorrect source/profile data and stale semantic precision. A rigorous lower bound excludes the next bit grid point for this same profile only.
